independent_premise_audit.non_split: PASS: split class is [-1]; quotient is [3]. If 3=Nm(a+bi) with a,b in Q, clearing denominators gives primitive x^2+y^2=3z^2; mod 3 forces x,y,z all divisible by 3.
independent_premise_audit.polarized_nonempty_family: PASS: E(x,y)=1/2 Tr(i h(x,y)) is integral alternating and J0=+i on positive coordinates, -i on negative coordinates makes E(x,J0x)>0.
independent_premise_audit.weil_space: PASS: W_K=Λ_K^6 H^1 is 1-dimensional over K and 2-dimensional over Q; after C-extension W_K,C=B_6⊕B_0 with B_p=Λ^p V_sigma⊗Λ^(6-p)V_sigma_bar, and both extreme blocks have Hodge type (3,3).
independent_premise_audit.very_general_NS: PASS at the declared very-general target: the generic unitary Hodge group has a 1-dimensional invariant in H^2 supplied by the polarization; extra rational (1,1) classes lie on proper rational Hodge loci, so NS(A_gen)_Q=Q[theta].
independent_premise_audit.divisor_separation: PASS: theta lies in the cross K-weight block, hence theta^3∈B_3 while W_K,C=B_0⊕B_6; therefore W_K∩Q[theta^3]=0.

typed_exceptional_projector.endomorphism: u=1+2i in Z[i], acting algebraically on A_gen
typed_exceptional_projector.kernel: direct sum of rational descents of B_p for p=1,...,5
typed_exceptional_projector.algebraicity: Pi_W is induced by a Q-linear combination of compositions of algebraic graph correspondences of the target endomorphism u.
typed_exceptional_projector.divisor_test: u^*(theta)=5 theta, so u^*(theta^3)=125 theta^3 and Pi_W(theta^3)=0.
typed_exceptional_projector.positive_seed_amplification: F0 has discriminant -7744, hence no Q-eigenline on W_K. If 0≠w∈W_K(Q) is algebraic, then {w,u^*w} is a Q-basis of W_K and both classes are algebraic.

projector_scope_caveat: The algebraic projector does not by itself create a nonzero algebraic class in W_K; it only isolates the exceptional component of an algebraic H^6 input. A positive seed still requires an algebraic input alpha with Pi_W(alpha)≠0.
